source_zh: 修复基线样本库（源自审计基线第 9/11 节），优先级：立即 / 短期 / 中期
source_en: Remediation baseline library (from audit master notes sections 9/11), priorities: immediate / short-term / mid-term

title.zh: vLLM Operator / KubeRay / LWS 集群级 RBAC 收敛为 namespace 角色
title.en: Scope vLLM Operator / KubeRay / LWS cluster-level RBAC down to namespace roles

remediation.zh: 撤销 operator ServiceAccount 的集群级角色绑定，改用最小权限 namespace Role；禁止 create rolebindings 指向 cluster-admin，配合准入规则阻断。
remediation.en: Remove cluster-level role bindings from operator ServiceAccounts and replace with least-privilege namespace Roles; block rolebindings targeting cluster-admin via admission rules.

title.zh: 推理引擎管理面端口鉴权与网络隔离
title.en: Authenticate and isolate inference-engine management ports

remediation.zh: 管理端口（权重拉取/环境注入/引擎创建等端点）默认不对外暴露：NetworkPolicy 限制到管理网段，端点强制鉴权并审计调用主体。
remediation.en: Keep management endpoints (weight pull, env injection, engine creation) off the data path: restrict to management CIDRs via NetworkPolicy and enforce authenticated, audited access.

title.zh: 泄露凭据轮换与 ServiceAccount token 约束
title.en: Rotate leaked credentials and constrain ServiceAccount tokens

remediation.zh: 轮换本次演练中可读的全部 Secret/令牌；automountServiceAccountToken 置 false，IMDSv2 强制 + 会话令牌最小化。
remediation.en: Rotate every secret/token readable during this exercise; set automountServiceAccountToken=false, enforce IMDSv2 and minimize session tokens.

title.zh: NetworkPolicy 默认拒绝 + 按域放行（per-CNI 变体）
title.en: Default-deny NetworkPolicy with per-domain allowances (per-CNI variants)

remediation.zh: 按 Ray 系统/训练/推理/监控分区实施默认拒绝（入站+出站），管理端口仅管理网段可达；按目标 CNI 输出原生/Calico/Cilium/云商变体。
remediation.en: Apply default-deny (ingress+egress) across Ray system / training / inference / monitoring zones with management CIDR-only access to admin ports; emit native/Calico/Cilium/CSP variants per target CNI.

title.zh: 特权 Pod 收敛与 Pod Security Standards 基线
title.en: Restrict privileged pods and adopt Pod Security Standards baselines

remediation.zh: 禁 privileged/hostPID/hostIPC/敏感 hostPath；restricted/baseline 准入基线 + GPU 必需权限例外通道；hostNetwork 部署清单化收敛。
remediation.en: Forbid privileged/hostPID/hostIPC/sensitive hostPath; enforce restricted/baseline admission with a GPU exception lane; inventory and shrink hostNetwork deployments.

title.zh: 镜像/端口组合准入（组合签名拦截）

remediation.zh: 对权重写端点 + 补丁栈镜像等高危组合签名实施准入拦截，命名空间级白名单管控。
remediation.en: Admission-block high-risk combination signatures such as weight-write endpoints coexisting with patched-stack images, governed by namespace allowlists.

title.zh: RDMA/InfiniBand 旁路隔离（NetworkPolicy 不覆盖面）
title.en: Isolate RDMA/InfiniBand bypass (not covered by NetworkPolicy)

remediation.zh: 显式声明 RDMA/SR-IOV/IB 路径不受 NetworkPolicy 覆盖：IB Partition/SM 按租户隔离，NCCL socket 入组白名单，hostNetwork 收敛清单。
remediation.en: Explicitly declare RDMA/SR-IOV/IB paths outside NetworkPolicy coverage: tenant-scoped IB partitions/SM, NCCL socket join allowlists, and a hostNetwork shrink list.

title.zh: SOC 检测规则部署与审计强化
title.en: Deploy SOC detection rules and harden auditing

remediation.zh: 部署随附 Sigma/Falco/Suricata 规则包（含零日行为化签名），开启 K8s 审计日志与权重目录写审计，紫队验证覆盖率矩阵。
remediation.en: Deploy the bundled Sigma/Falco/Suricata rule pack (including behavioral zero-day signatures), enable Kubernetes audit logs and weight-directory write auditing, and verify the coverage matrix purple-team style.

title.zh: 通用立即项：暴露面收敛与凭据复核
title.en: Generic immediate: shrink exposure and review credentials

remediation.zh: 对高危/超危发现先做暴露面收敛（网络隔离 + 鉴权），并复核涉及的凭据与数据访问路径。
remediation.en: For high/critical findings first shrink exposure (network isolation + authentication) and review the credentials and data access paths involved.

title.zh: 通用短期项：策略与准入基线化
title.en: Generic short-term: baseline policies and admission

remediation.zh: 将临时处置固化为策略：默认拒绝网络策略、准入基线与角色最小化改写。
remediation.en: Turn interim mitigations into policy: default-deny network policy, admission baselines and least-privilege role rewrites.

title.zh: 通用中期项：检测闭环与架构加固
title.en: Generic mid-term: detection loop and architecture hardening

remediation.zh: 建立检测—验证闭环：规则包部署、紫队复测、网络分层与混合云边界架构加固。
remediation.en: Establish a detection-verification loop: rule pack rollout, purple-team retests, layered-network and hybrid-boundary hardening.
